name: Repository
summary: A collection-like interface onto domain objects, behind which the mapping to storage disappears.

roles.name: Repository
roles.summary: What client code asks for objects. It reads as an in-memory collection — add, remove, and queries phrased in the domain's own language — so that no caller is written in terms of storage. Criteria are passed as objects rather than as a query language, which is what keeps the illusion intact.
